formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p15_t1_frobenius_submultiplicative {n : Nat} (A B : P15Matrix n) : p15FrobNorm (p15MatMul A B) <= p15FrobNorm A * p15FrobNorm B
formal_statement.plain_language: The Frobenius norm of a finite matrix product is at most the product of the two Frobenius norms.

informal_proof: Identify the paper-scoped finite product and Frobenius norm with the native matrix product and Frobenius norm, then apply Frobenius submultiplicativity.
